step1_analysis.description: This circuit converts a PMOS bias voltage (VBP) into an NMOS bias voltage (VBN) using a PMOS current source driving a diode-connected NMOS.

paper_reference.title: Techniques for Phase Noise Suppression in Recirculating DLLs

I_bias.description: DC bias current flowing through the branch

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using the square law model for PMOS with VBP=0.99V.

VBN_dc.description: Generated DC bias voltage for NMOS

sky130_expected.calculation: VBN = Vth_n + sqrt(2 * Id / (un*Cox * W/L)) = 0.42 + sqrt(2 * 38u / (270u * 10)) = 0.587 V
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the diode-connected NMOS sinking the PMOS current.

Power_DC.description: DC power consumption of the bias branch

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to the bias current and supply voltage.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the DC operating point of the bias circuit to determine bias current, generated VBN voltage, and power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Bias Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

XM2 VBN VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 VBN VBN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBP VBP 0 0.99

.control
op
let i_bias = -i(VVDD)
let vbn_dc = v(VBN)
let power = i_bias * 1.8

print i_bias
print vbn_dc
print power

* DC sweep to observe VBN generation over VBP range
dc VVBP 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc vbn_at_vbp99 find v(VBN) at=0.99
meas dc ibias_at_vbp99 find i(VVDD) at=0.99
quit
.endc
.end
